caption: The drawing depicts a metallic tankard, rendered in grayscale pencil on a beige or light tan background. The tankard is cylindrical, flaring slightly outward towards the base, with a rounded rim at the top and a raised band around the upper section. It has a large, curved handle attached at the upper and lower right side, with a small thumb rest near the top attachment. The tankard is shown in a three-quarter view, with smooth, shaded surfaces suggesting a reflective metal texture. The main drawing is enclosed within a large, lightly drawn rectangular border. Below the main image, there is a smaller, simple outline sketch of the tankard, also within a square border, showing a side profile of the tankard with its handle. To the right of the smaller sketch is a cursive signature reading "Charles Cullen." The drawing is monochromatic, using different shades of gray to create volume and highlights.
title: Pewter Mug
